```{python}
import json

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from itables import show

BANDS = ["No risk", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Unfit"]
# Light to dark: no risk palest, unfit darkest.
BAND_COLORS = ["#fde0c5", "#facba6", "#f59e72", "#d45d2b", "#7f2704"]

clusters = pd.read_parquet("outputs/clusters.parquet")
profiles = pd.read_csv("outputs/cluster_profiles.csv").set_index("cluster")

# GeoJSON follows RFC 7946 (exterior rings counter-clockwise); Plotly expects the
# opposite winding, so reverse every ring in memory (data/ stays unchanged).
geo = json.load(open("data/municipios.geojson"))
for f in geo["features"]:
    g = f["geometry"]
    polys = [g["coordinates"]] if g["type"] == "Polygon" else g["coordinates"]
    for poly in polys:
        for i, ring in enumerate(poly):
            poly[i] = ring[::-1]
codes = [f["properties"]["divipola"] for f in geo["features"]]
names = {f["properties"]["divipola"]: f"{f['properties']['municipio'].title()}, "
         f"{f['properties']['departamento'].title()}" for f in geo["features"]}

urban = clusters[clusters["zone"] == "urban"]
years = sorted(urban["year"].unique())


def band_z(year):
    """Band index (0 = no risk … 4 = unfit) for every polygon; None = no value."""
    b = urban[urban["year"] == year].set_index("divipola")["irca_band"]
    return [BANDS.index(b[c]) if c in b.index else None for c in codes]


n = len(BANDS)
colorscale = []
for i, c in enumerate(BAND_COLORS):
    colorscale += [[i / n, c], [(i + 1) / n, c]]
hover = [names[c] for c in codes]
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Urban zones: utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA band, by year"
base = go.Choropleth(geojson=geo, locations=codes, z=[0] * len(codes),
                     featureidkey="properties.divipola",
                     colorscale=[[0, "#d9d9d9"], [1, "#d9d9d9"]], showscale=False,
                     marker_line_width=0.2, marker_line_color="white",
                     hoverinfo="skip")
first = go.Choropleth(
    geojson=geo, locations=codes, z=band_z(years[-1]), featureidkey="properties.divipola",
    zmin=-0.5, zmax=n - 0.5, colorscale=colorscale, marker_line_width=0.2,
    marker_line_color="white", text=hover,
    hovertemplate="%{text}<br>IRCA band: %{customdata}<extra></extra>",
    customdata=[BANDS[z] if z is not None else "no data" for z in band_z(years[-1])],
    colorbar=dict(title="IRCA band", tickvals=list(range(n)), ticktext=BANDS, len=0.8))
fig = go.Figure(data=[base, first])
# Frames update only z (and the hover label) of the coloured trace, never the geometry.
fig.frames = [go.Frame(name=str(y), traces=[1],
                       data=[go.Choropleth(z=band_z(y), customdata=[
                           BANDS[z] if z is not None else "no data" for z in band_z(y)])])
              for y in years]
fig = fig.update_layout(
    sliders=[dict(active=len(years) - 1, currentvalue=dict(prefix="Year: "),
                  steps=[dict(label=str(y), method="animate",
                              args=[[str(y)], dict(mode="immediate", frame=dict(duration=0, redraw=True),
                                                   transition=dict(duration=0))])
                         for y in years])],
    geo=dict(fitbounds="locations", visible=False),
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0))
fig
```

#| title: "The four kinds of municipal zone"

    columns={"name": "Kind", "rows": "Zone-years", "municipalities": "Municipalities",

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Clustered zone-years, 2016–2023 (outputs/clusters.parquet)"
cols = ["divipola", "municipio", "departamento", "zone", "year", "cluster", "irca",
        "irca_band", "water_coverage", "sewer_coverage", "ipm", "infant_mortality",
        "saber11_mean", "dropout_rate"]
table = clusters[cols].copy()
table["municipio"] = table["municipio"].str.title()
table["departamento"] = table["departamento"].str.title()
table["irca_band"] = table["irca_band"].astype(str)
show(table, classes="display compact", pageLength=10, scrollX=True, maxBytes=0)
```

::: {.card title="About"}
IRCA is the utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA from INS open data (datos.gov.co
`nxt2-39c3`); bands from Resolución 2115 de 2007. Grey: no value or not clustered.
Outcomes describe the kinds and were never used to form them; differences are descriptive
and do not establish causal effects of water quality.
:::
